name: faker-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Faker, a Python library that generates fake data: a `Faker` proxy over one or
more localized generators, standard providers for names, addresses, numbers, dates, codes and identifiers, a
`.unique` and an `.optional` proxy, seeding, a pytest plugin and a command line.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Faker's core and its standard providers: every module directly in the faker package (faker/*.py), the packages faker/utils/, faker/contrib/ and faker/sphinx/, the module faker/providers/__init__.py, the generic modules of each standard provider package (faker/providers/<provider>/__init__.py, plus faker/providers/color/color.py, faker/providers/isbn/isbn.py, faker/providers/sbn/sbn.py and faker/providers/sbn/rules.py), and the localized ssn providers faker/providers/ssn/<locale>/__init__.py of the locales ar_DZ, de_AT, de_DE, el_GR, en_CA, en_IN, en_US, es_CL, es_CO, es_ES, es_MX, et_EE, fi_FI, fr_CH, fr_FR, hr_HR, lv_LV, mk_MK, nl_BE, nl_NL, no_NO, pl_PL, pt_BR, ro_RO, sr_BA, sv_SE, th_TH and uk_UA; together with README.rst, docs/fakerclass.rst, docs/pytest-fixtures.rst, docs/writing-docs.rst and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
